schema.description:
The redirect-SCA start response: the ASPSP SCA page URL + the
authorisation id the callback carries back.

authorisationId.description: The authorisation sub-resource id (echoed by the callback).

redirectUrl.description: The ASPSP SCA page the PSU is redirected to.

status.description: The ceremony status (`sca_started` once the redirect is served).

schema.title: RedirectStartResponse

400.description: The ceremony is not a redirect ceremony
